q_001: Apple's total net revenue in fiscal year 2025 was $416,161,000,000.
q_006: Apple disclosed supply chain risks including supplier code of conduct violations that could harm its business and reputation; the time, resources, and regulatory exposure from supply chain changes; dependence on single or limited sources for components, subject to shortages and pricing fluctuations; and reliance on custom components from sole sources, with capacity constraints and supplier.
q_008: In fiscal year 2025, 51.3% of Microsoft's total revenue came from the United States. This is based on US revenue of $144,546,000,000 and total revenue of $281,724,000,000.
q_011: Alphabet (GOOGL) had the fastest revenue growth between FY2024 and FY2025 at approximately 15.1%.
q_012: Apple's Greater China net sales decreased from $66.952 billion in fiscal 2024 to $64.377 billion in fiscal 2025, a decline of $2.575 billion. The 10-K filing attributes this primarily to lower iPhone sales, partially offset by higher Mac sales.
q_014: Productivity and Business Processes ($120.8 billion) primarily comprises Microsoft 365 Commercial and Consumer, LinkedIn, and Dynamics. Intelligent Cloud ($106.3 billion) consists of public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services. More Personal Computing revenue was $54.6 billion.
q_017: Google Services revenue splits into Google advertising—Google Search & other, YouTube ads, and Google Network—and Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices (consumer subs like YouTube and Google One, Google Play, Pixel, and related). YouTube advertising revenue was about $36.1 billion in FY2024 and about $40.4 billion in FY2025, up roughly $4.2 billion YoY (about 11.7%).
q_018: Alphabet (GOOGL) has the highest current ratio in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025) at approximately 2.01x.
q_022: Alphabet (GOOGL) saw the largest absolute revenue increase between FY2024 and FY2025, rising by $52.8 billion. Google Services: +$37.8 billion. Google Cloud: +$15.5 billion. Hedging gains (losses): -$338.0 million. Other Bets: -$111.0 million.
q_025: Services revenue grew 12.9% in FY2024 and 13.5% in FY2025, versus iPhone's 0.3% and 4.2%. Apple's 10-K underscores Services' strategic importance as a high-margin segment (gross margin ~75% in FY2025) that fuels overall revenue growth and diversification.
